              FROM THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE CITY O

                   IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF OHIO
                    ELEVENTH APPELLATE DISTRICT
                           PORTAGE COUNTY

STATE OF OHIO,                                    CASE NO. 2025-P-0047

                 Plaintiff-Appellee,
                                                  Criminal Appeal from the
        - vs -                                    Court of Common Pleas

ERIK A. CUNNINGHAM,

results.syllabus: CRIMINAL LAW - murder; two firearm specifications; bench trial; no dispute that husband committed murder of wife; husband surrendered to police; methamphetamine use on night of murder; prior methamphetamine use; opioid polysubstance background; husband psychologically evaluated the day prior to murder; husband not admitted to care center; paranoia; electronics disassembled; holes in walls of residence; evidence husband assaulted wife prior to murder; not guilty by reason of insanity; manifest weight of the evidence; three experts offered to support State's position; voluntary intoxication; four experts offered to support defense of not guilty by reason of insanity; trial court did not err in finding husband's acts were not result of severe mental disease or defect; induced paranoia consistent with methamphetamine use; trial court did not err in finding husband knew wrongfulness of actions; post-murder actions; fabrications to others; told child not to say anything even though child heard gunshots; husband cut power to residence; circumstantial evidence demonstrates that at the time of the offense husband's actions were such that he failed to meet elements of not guilty by reason of insanity; trial court's conclusion consistent with manifest weight of the evidence; no error in allowing State's expert to use a prior report of a non-testifying witness as a foundation for expert's opinion; no confrontation clause violation.
